title: Verification index
summary: Auditable verification baseline for the spec suite.
body:
UI Kit Verification Index

This folder contains the auditable verification layer for the Incursa UI kit spec suite, including the shared foundation specs and the component conformance baseline.

- VER-UIK-0001 - source-review baseline for the revised public UI kit surface
- VER-UIK-0002 - repo-local smoke validation for the packaged public surface
- VER-UIK-0003 - browser automation baseline for the existing helper-managed surface
- VER-UIK-0004 - browser automation coverage for the Web Component layer
